_label: F2/M31 pin: two 'guard' entries sharing the same name. The first is GOOD (CheckRun, __typename present, COMPLETED/SUCCESS). The second is BAD (COMPLETED/FAILURE) and deliberately OMITS the __typename field entirely -- every other fixture in this suite carries __typename on every entry, which is exactly what let a mutant add 'and e.get("__typename") in ("CheckRun","StatusContext")' to the matches comprehension and survive: it silently drops any entry lacking that field from evaluation, so a bad sibling missing __typename would never be seen. The contract evaluates every entry bearing the required name regardless of whether it carries __typename -- entries must never be dropped by an incidental field an entry-selection filter wasn't asked to check.
